mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (user_id, project_id, target_type, target_id, action, detail, ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{ip})
mapper.select:
SELECT l.id, l.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, l.project_id, p.name AS project_name, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.action, l.detail, l.ip, l.created_at FROM operation_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN project p ON p.id = l.project_id
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
